title: holds a command chosen before the page listens
why: The held command never sent: a command chosen with no window open, or before the page subscribed, would be lost.

find: if (pending === null || this.#deps.now() - pending.at > HELD_MS) return
title: drops a held command that has waited longer than it may
why: The held command's age ignored: a choice made long ago would be acted on whenever a page next listened.

title: sends only to the frame that said it listens
why: A command sent to whatever page the window holds, though it never said it listens: the command is lost on a page that has not subscribed.

title: forgets what it held when the renderer dies
why: A choice made over a crash kept: the page that replaces the dead one would act on it.
